rationale: A unanimous, institution-protective holding narrowing collateral-order review in a fact-bound Yearsley posture is most naturally assigned to Justice Kagan or Justice Barrett, who emphasized Cohen separateness, Johnson v. Jones, and Hallock/Mohawk restraint. Some chance of separate concurrences exists to stress § 1291 textualism (Thomas/Gorsuch) or to cabin the holding to denials turning on disputed authorization/compliance facts (Roberts/Kavanaugh).
